claims: The number 4 is a natural number.
The number 4 is an even integer.
The number 4 is the smallest composite number.
The number 4 is a cardinal number.
The number 4 is a square number.
A polygon with four sides and vertices is a quadrilateral.
The number 4 is the second tetrahedral number.
The quaternary numeral system uses 4 as its base.
The number 4 is the only integer whose name has the same number of letters as its value.
In digital displays, the number 4 is sometimes shown as a "Lego hand" shape to distinguish it from the number 9.
In cricket, a "four" is a boundary score.
The FOUR score is used to assess coma severity.
The Enneagram personality type "Four" is known as the "Individualist".
